output: Your concern is a fair one: if clinic managers can't update their own staffing numbers, the work lands back with you. Model building does have a learning curve, and most non-finance users should start by entering and reviewing numbers rather than designing models. The input views are organized by role, so a clinic manager sees the staffing fields they own, and the admin training included in onboarding prepares a trained internal admin to handle routine model changes without needing a consultant. [PROOF] We would suggest a hands-on session where two of your non-finance budget owners complete a real input task in a sandbox, so you can see how it works for your own managers before you decide.
